dp.label: Data Parallelism
dp.name: Data Parallelism
dp.tagline: Shard the batch. Replicate the weights.

fsdp.label: FSDP (ZeRO-3)
fsdp.name: Fully-Sharded Data Parallelism (ZeRO-3)
fsdp.tagline: Shard the weights too. Gather them just-in-time.

tp.label: Tensor Parallelism
tp.name: Tensor Parallelism (Megatron)
tp.tagline: Shard the features and heads. AllGather in, ReduceScatter out.

cp.label: Context Parallelism
cp.name: Context Parallelism
cp.tagline: Shard the sequence. Only attention needs to talk.

ep.label: Expert Parallelism
ep.name: Expert Parallelism (MoE)
ep.tagline: Shard the experts. Route tokens with AllToAll.

pp.label: Pipeline Parallelism
pp.name: Pipeline Parallelism
pp.tagline: Shard the layers. Keep every stage busy with microbatches.

5d.label: 5D Parallelism
5d.name: 5D Parallelism
5d.tagline: FSDP × TP × CP × EP × PP — every axis at once, every collective attributed.
5d.meshh: Mesh({'X': 2, 'Y': 2, 'C': 2, 'Z': 2, 'stage': 2})

zero1.label: ZeRO-1 Data Parallelism
zero1.name: ZeRO-1 Data Parallelism
zero1.tagline: Replicate the weights; shard the optimizer. ReduceScatter, step, AllGather.

dense4d.label: Dense 4D (Llama 3 style)
dense4d.name: Dense 4D Parallelism
dense4d.tagline: Llama 3 style: FSDP × TP × CP × PP on a dense transformer.

moe4d.label: MoE 4D (DeepSeek / Kimi style)
moe4d.name: MoE 4D Parallelism
moe4d.tagline: DeepSeek / Kimi style: EP × CP × PP × ZeRO-1 data parallelism, no TP.
